construct.diagnosis_or_process: Nephrogenic syndrome of inappropriate antidiuresis due to activating AVPR2 variants
construct.mechanism: Gain-of-function AVPR2 variants constitutively activate the renal vasopressin V2 receptor in collecting-duct principal cells even without AVP. Persistent cAMP-dependent aquaporin-2 trafficking increases free-water reabsorption, causing hypotonic hyponatremia with inappropriately concentrated urine and suppressed endogenous vasopressin.
construct.primary_competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts

source_verification.locator: Respiratory & Renal/Urinary Systems; Medical Knowledge competency
Other disorders — nephrogenic syndrome of inappropriate antidiuresis
source_verification.claim: States that NSIAD AVPR2 variants produce constitutively activated V2 receptors, excessive water reabsorption, concentrated urine, hyponatremia, and serum hypo-osmolality.

second_answer_attack.strongest_alternative: Classic SIADH from excess pituitary vasopressin.
second_answer_attack.resolution: Both produce hypotonic hyponatremia with concentrated urine, but endogenous AVP is undetectable and the patient has an activating AVPR2 variant. Constitutive renal V2-receptor signaling explains antidiuresis without hormone excess.
